candidates.findings: Sheet of 40 Australian florins: about half are George V and early George VI pre-1946 sterling (92.5%, about 10.5g fine silver each), dates read include 1923-1936 era types and 1938-1946 George VI; post-1946 50% silver Elizabeth II types to about 1960; includes two 1951 Jubilee florins and two 1954 Royal Visit florins. Total silver content probably 300g or more fine silver. No key dates seen at this resolution (1932, 1933 can't be confirmed).
candidates.condition: Circulated, mixed grades, some toning; housed in plastic album sheet.
candidates.rescore_note: 40 pre-decimal silver florins, about 300g fine silver; bullion value in the $300-500 range, no confirmed key dates.

candidates.rescore_note: Three worn silver pocket watches, unreadable hallmarks, non-running; silver and parts value only.
